name: 15137-sharegpt-1b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine, one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 350 streams held in flight, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 6000 requests with a 900 s safety cap. 350 is the declared operating point and is a floor, not a value to reduce.
workload: single-turn streaming chat, ShareGPT-shaped. synthetic_text, prompt_tokens 200 stdev 200 clipped to [16, 1024], output_tokens 180 stdev 180 clipped to [16, 1024], realised as mean 219 prompt / 197 output tokens. Responses are streamed token by token. request_format plain: the raw prompt string reaches the engine with no chat template around it, so the wire length equals the declared length.
purpose: A streaming chat assistant on a compact Llama model, serving 350 concurrent short conversations from one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM commit 7c02d6a137867a2c4007c6ff991922426af55124 (v0.8.4-62-g7c02d6a13786), built in
# process with AsyncLLMEngine.from_engine_args. One H100 80GB, TP=1.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# The in-process engine does not pick up the `vllm serve` batch defaults, so both are pinned
# rather than left to fall through to 128 / 2048; 512 keeps all 350 declared streams resident.
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: true
